title_line: Field Quality & Returns Leader  |  PMP  |  CSPO
summary: Quality and operations leader who has run returns, root cause investigation, and supplier corrective action for hardware built overseas. At Lion Energy, Eric improved intake, barcode traceability, and defect documentation for a partner-return operation handling about 10,000 returns a year, cutting return-to-resolution time about 50% and root cause turnaround from months to roughly one week. Earlier roles at Vivint and Aptive added KPI reporting to executives, team supervision, and Jira and Confluence workflow design. He has sold and supported smart-home systems, so he knows what a field failure costs an installer and an end customer, and he wants to bring that view to field quality for connected hardware.
skills: Root cause analysis and supplier corrective action

paragraphs: Returns data only matters when it reaches the people who can fix the part. That's the problem I spent most of my time at Lion Energy working on, and it's the heart of the field quality job you've posted in Lehi.

Lion's partner return operation handled about 10,000 units a year. When I started, a root cause investigation could take months. I improved intake, barcode tracking, and defect documentation so engineering and our manufacturers in China and Vietnam had something they could act on. Investigations dropped to about a week. Return to resolution time fell roughly 50%, yearly RMAs fell 10%, and partner returns fell 15% over several months. We estimated about $100,000 in first year savings on processing, storage, and labor.

I've also spent years putting KPIs in front of leadership, first coordinating a four person analytics team at Vivint and later as a product owner at Aptive. But what pulls me toward ADI is the product. I've sold and supported smart home systems, and I know what a failed device costs an installer and the customer behind them. I'd like to walk you through how I'd run quality holds and returns across your regions. Could we set up a call next week?
